import csv, hashlib, io, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/services/agency-launch-qa-pilot')
page = (root / 'controls/example-home.html').read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(page).hexdigest()
assert digest == '25ddf2c883e0d1958ea971d279a7e4f0fd446724ee3db7db19dadabd4a62e484'
control = (root / 'launch-qa-delivery-control.md').read_bytes()
rows = [{'route': 'https://example.com/', 'task': 'TASK-179557416100', 'outcome': 'retrieved', 'evidence': 'HTTP 200 with committed body and verified SHA-256 ' + digest}, {'route': '404 control', 'task': 'TASK-179557416101', 'outcome': 'fetch refused', 'evidence': 'The host reported HTTP 404 and supplied no committed body'}]
columns = ['route', 'task', 'outcome', 'evidence']
buffer = io.StringIO(newline='')
writer = csv.DictWriter(buffer, fieldnames=columns)
writer.writeheader()
writer.writerows(rows)
report = buffer.getvalue()
assert list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(report))) == rows
(root / 'buyer-report-control.csv').write_text(report, encoding='utf-8', newline='')
result = {'scope': 'Two public control observations from host receipts supplied in the world snapshot', 'existing_control_sha256': hashlib.sha256(control).hexdigest(), 'checks': ['Retrieved body matches the recorded digest', 'CSV round-trip preserves both outcomes', 'Refusal retains host wording and stays distinct from retrieval'], 'delivery_limits': ['No buyer URLs checked', 'Browser rendering and final redirect behavior were not verified', 'Report blocked or ambiguous checks separately and count them toward the agreed ten-link scope'], 'commercial_state': 'No customer delivery, acceptance or settlement established'}
(root / 'buyer-report-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result))
